data.rule: When a salvaged/stale worktree's commit hook dies with 'unknown knob' on the primary's .ddflow/config.toml, set the uncommitted work aside as a patch, run 'git merge main --no-commit', commit the merge, then re-apply and commit the work.
data.title: A branch cut before a config knob cannot commit until it merges main: merge with --no-commit first
data.why: The hook runs 'python -m ddflow', which puts the worktree's cwd first on sys.path, so the branch's OLD ddflow code reads the primary's NEWER config and refuses the unknown knob on every commit, including the salvage commit (B-precommit-companion, 2026-09-29; B9cb7dd1c3b fixed tolerance only for code containing the fix).
